summary_markdown: The conversation focused on the feasibility of training a point cloud classification model to identify objects such as people, bicycles, cars, and trams. Several external resources (links) were shared detailing PointNet architectures and related research papers. It was determined that a Proof of Concept (POC) is necessary for this task. Participants noted experience with deep learning frameworks like Keras and PyTorch, suggesting an attempt using the model architecture from one of the provided links on PyTorch.
decisions: A POC must be created to test point cloud classification.
